tools.name: team_archive_member
tools.description: Archive ONE member instance (move it out of the main active work set; durable, Leader-only). For a legal archive target (RUNNING or SETTLED), the lifecycle authority quiesces the member first (its current work is interrupted and its resident descendants drained), then commits durably: a SETTLED member takes one durable ARCHIVE commit, while a RUNNING member takes a durable SETTLE commit followed by the ARCHIVE commit (two durable commits — the frozen lifecycle FSM has no RUNNING → ARCHIVED edge). CREATED, ARCHIVED, and DISPOSED targets are rejected before any live effect. The archived member no longer accepts new Team work until it is explicitly restored. The durable change is committed through the lifecycle authority and recorded as a member-lifecycle-changed fact. Guarded on the target (a pending control request blocks the operation).

tools.name: team_grant_permission
tools.description: Grant durable permission-overlay rules to ONE member instance (Leader-only; the ONE governance mutation authority). Rules are closed {operationClass, matcher: {kind: exact|subtree, value: <path>} OR {kind: exec, intent: {tool: bash|pwsh, command, workdir?, run_in_background?, timeoutMs?, sandbox_permissions?}}, effect: allow|ask|deny}; file values are canonicalized SERVER-SIDE at the ADDRESSED team's TARGET member effective workspace and exec intents are canonicalized SERVER-SIDE to the EXACT execution fingerprint the pre-execute plane computes (a client-supplied key or fingerprint string is never the authority). The target must have a durable row and not be DISPOSED (unknown/DISPOSED refuse typed, zero write; ARCHIVED stays legally mutable and never executes). The mutation is classified against the bound Blueprint's permissionMutationEnvelope carrier: a tightening applies immediately; an EXPANSION requires explicit carrier coverage and refuses typed (zero write) otherwise. On a schemaVersion-3 Blueprint the same expansion must ALSO stay inside BOTH authority ceilings — the Team's teamHardEnvelope and the Leader's own carrier, evaluated separately and never merged; a rise above either refuses typed as PERMISSION_AUTHORITY_CEILING_INSUFFICIENT (needing higher authority is a REFUSAL, never a pending request, until the escalation path lands), and a ceiling document that cannot be read refuses as a context fault rather than being treated as absent. Replays commit nothing (a rule-set-equal mutation no-ops). Does NOT change the Leader's own permissions.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Run commands in a persistent bash shell. State, including the current directory and exported environment variables, persists across calls for this agent.

command.description: The bash command to run. Relative path is preferred in the command.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Perform exact string replacements in one governed file inside this member's admitted file root. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused. old_string must appear verbatim (and uniquely unless replace_all is true); the edit never creates a file.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it

old_string.description: the exact text to replace (non-empty, must appear verbatim)

replace_all.description: replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match (default false)

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read one governed text file inside this member's admitted file root. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it

offset.description: The line number to start reading from. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once.

limit.description: The number of lines to read. Only provide if the file is too large to read at once. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read one governed image file inside this member's admitted file root and attach it to the conversation. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused. The file is durably committed to the session's attachment store and referenced as an image block.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it

tools.name: team_bash
tools.description: Governed shell (a5p5 lane): opaque command text decided by admission + the confined backend; deny-before-backend.

tools.name: team_collect
tools.description: Read the durable state of admitted work units by their request tokens (the async work-status read-back): each token reports running (the async continuation is still in flight, or the chain crashed before settlement — a same-token re-delegate RESUMES the unit instead of admitting a second one) or the terminal member result (succeeded / failed / unavailable, served verbatim from the durable settlement fact). Read-only: it writes nothing and delivers nothing.

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

requestTokens.description: The work request tokens to read: the requestToken each team_delegate / team_follow_up call was given (1..64 non-empty strings, max 128 chars each).

tools.name: team_cordis_inspect_list
tools.description: List every Cordis Inspect Provider currently known to the Host, governed: the listing is read through the host registry public face after PA admission. Each entry includes its platform, purpose, read-only methods, and input/output schemas. Call this tool before configuring a plugin, then select the provider and method for team_cordis_inspect_query from its result. Do not guess names or treat an Inspect method as a business Service that plugin code can call.

tools.name: team_cordis_inspect_query
tools.description: Run a read-only query declared by an Inspect Provider, governed: platform, provider, and method must come from team_cordis_inspect_list, and input must satisfy that method's schema (invalid or unverifiable input is refused before dispatch). The query waits under a bounded settle race: on timeout or cancellation the call answers a typed refusal and a late result is NEVER delivered. This tool cannot invoke business Service methods or modify the runtime.

platform.description: Runtime platform that owns the Provider.

provider.description: Exact Provider ID returned by team_cordis_inspect_list.

method.description: Exact method name declared by the Provider manifest.

input.description: Optional query input; it must satisfy the method input schema. (Any JSON value; a node without `type` is the host subset's unconstrained form.)

tools.name: team_create_member
tools.description: Create a NEW member instance from a blueprint template (explicit creation; the activation authority enforces quota, envelope, and gates).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

delegationTemplateId.description: The blueprint template id the new member is created from.

label.description: A short human-readable label for the new member instance (non-empty).

groupId.description: Optional group id for the new member.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path override for the new member.

tools.name: team_delegate
tools.description: Delegate work: either create a NEW member from a template and admit the work on it, or admit new work on an EXISTING member instance. Provide exactly one of delegationTemplateId / delegationInstanceId. Asynchronous by default: with no async argument the work is admitted durably and the call returns immediately (the response carries the admission receipt — workStatus "admitted", settled false, no result); read the terminal result back with team_collect (the same request token). Pass async: false for the synchronous behavior (the call returns when the work unit has settled and the member result is in the response).

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

delegationTemplateId.description: Present: create a new member from this template and delegate to it.

delegationInstanceId.description: Present: delegate new work to this existing member instance (its persistent context is kept).

label.description: A short human-readable label for the new member instance (non-empty).

groupId.description: Optional group id for a new member.

workspace.description: Optional workspace path override for a new member.

taskSummary.description: Optional short summary of the delegated work unit (audit context).

prompt.description: REQUIRED: the exact work prompt delivered (model-visible) to the member's bound child session. No default inheritance from the caller or sibling transcripts.

attachedContext.description: Optional explicit context attached to the work unit and delivered with the prompt.

async.description: Optional (default true when omitted): the DEFAULT is ASYNCHRONOUS — with no argument the call returns as soon as the durable admission is committed (the response effect carries workStatus "admitted", settled false, and NO member result); the terminal result is then read back with team_collect. Pass async: false for the synchronous behavior (the call blocks until the work unit settles and the response carries the member result — reserve it for work you know will not wait on a leader approval, which the Leader cannot resolve from inside a blocked turn).

tools.description: Governed filename traversal (a5p5 lane): pattern + target ONLY; admission-gated before any backend runs.

tools.name: team_grep
tools.description: Governed search (a5p5 lane): strict pattern search over the realm; effects derived read-time, admission-gated before any backend runs.

tools.description: List every member instance of the team with its template id, label, lifecycle state, and bound child session id.

rootSessionId.description: The TeamSession (root session) id this operation belongs to.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

tools.name: team_list_pending_control
tools.description: List this Team's unresolved approvals across every carrier: each open approval case at its CURRENT leg (whatever rung that leg is waiting on and whichever carrier it rides), plus any pending legacy request. requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

limit.description: Optional: the maximum number of pending requests to return (default 50, minimum 1, maximum 100).

tools.name: team_resolve_control
tools.description: Record an allow/deny decision on a pending control request, or ESCALATE the leg when its reviewer judges the case above its rung (resolver roles per kind: leader-approval -> leader|human, user-approval -> human only, envelope-mutation -> leader|human; a member is never a resolver). An allow authorizes the exact scope exactly once, consumed by the last-mile guard. Escalate closes THIS leg with a terminal deny(reason 'escalated'), records the reviewer's escalation fact, and passes the case to the next rung on the closed successor ladder; the escalating reviewer can no longer act on the case.

requestToken.description: A token unique to THIS logical operation (non-empty, max 128 chars). Reuse the exact same token only when retrying the same logical operation; never reuse it for a different one.

requestId.description: The durable control request id to decide (max 128 chars).

tools.name: team_skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for a skill, governed: reads only the host-sanctioned skill root(s) this mount configures, resolves the name through the anchor law (no parent segments, no symlink escape), and refuses unknown skills. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.description: Create or fully replace one governed UTF-8 text file inside this member's admitted file root. Paths resolve against that root; escaping targets are refused. Overwrites an existing file only when the target is a regular file.

file_path.description: path relative to the governed root, or an absolute path inside it

content.description: the full UTF-8 content to write (empty string clears the file)
